description: This Java source file defines the CommandClientImpl class, which is an implementation of the CommandClient interface for interacting with Hono's Command and Control API using Vertx and Proton. It provides methods to send commands synchronously and asynchronously to IoT devices, managing AMQP links and message construction. It includes functionality for creating command clients scoped to specific tenants and devices, handles message IDs, and manages message sending and response processing.

classes.name: CommandClientImpl
classes.description: An implementation of CommandClient that uses Vertx and Proton to send commands over AMQP to IoT devices within Hono platform.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new CommandClient instance scoped to a specific tenant and device, establishing AMQP links.

methods.name: sendCommand
methods.description: Sends a command message to a specified device and command type, returning a Future with the result.

methods.name: sendOneWayCommand
methods.description: Sends a one-way command without expecting a response.

methods.name: createMessageId
methods.description: Generates a unique message ID based on an internal counter.

methods.name: getTargetAddress
methods.description: Constructs the target address for sending commands based on tenant and device IDs.
